technology_name: Fish Gelatin Based Sugar Coated Gummy
institution: Kerala University of Fisheries and Ocean Studies (KUFOS)
problem_solved: Need for gelatin-free or non-bovine gummy formulations
description: This sugar-coated gummy is prepared using fish gelatin obtained from collagen present in fish skin and bones. Fish gelatin acts as an active ingredient in the formulation and serves as an alternative to conventional mammalian gelatin sources. The product is developed as a chewable confectionery item with a sugar coating.
applications:
Confectionery and gummy candy manufacturing companies
Fish processing and marine by-product utilization enterprises
Specialty gelatin and food ingredient manufacturers
Functional and protein-enriched food product companies
Agri-food startups developing innovative marine-based confectionery products
